lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately four horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with the highest-intensity local maxima concentrated in the mid-lateral region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Diffuse vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal blob rows, forming a faint rectangular grid-like pattern across the mid-section of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible running horizontally across the upper flank, characterized by a sharp transition from high luminance on the dorsal aspect to deep shadow on the ventral aspect.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A visible notch or irregular indentation is present on the posterior trailing edge of the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Two small yellow teleost fish are positioned near the ventral margin of the gill slits. High-contrast solar caustic patterns are projected across the dorsal-lateral skin surface.
